title: Fatal Attraction
author: Roger Auman
notes: The Caller's Box 10426, permission: full. The dance travels round the **major** set twice - 156 duple dances in the corpus do - and the promenade is what carries you to N2. A2's first two beats are the milestone's concurrency test: `(2) Women cast back || Men go forward`, two figures over disjoint dancers at the same beats, and they dance. "Men go forward" is a **dance-local figure** (D10). **The progression is carried by a figure in the middle of the dance** (M9b): A2's cast-back writes `"params": { "progresses": true }`, the clause `docs/dance-record.md` now documents, so the set's slots shift at the end of that call and everything after it resolves from one place along. The transcript's "N2 neighbor" is therefore written as `neighbors` from A2 on - the caller's own word is kept in each call's text - because after the shift the couple the promenade carried you round to **is** your neighbour. **Measured before and after, at every checked length (4-12):** reach went from **22.2982 px short** to **0.0000-2.6104 px**, which is the whole point - before the clause the dancer `N2` named was at every length a couple standing out, so A2's shoulder round, A2's swing and B1's promenade cast nobody at all and only A1's promenade travelled. `progressed` went from **68.0000 px** to **32.0000/37.7359 px**. Closure went the other way, from **18.8680-25.6125 px** to a uniform **37.7359 px**, and that is the one thing left. **Still owed, one thing, measured:** closure **37.7359 px**, and it is the same seam at every length - `walk-to-station -> allemande` at beat 40 (beat 168 at nine couples, 104 at ten), for the robin of a couple that was **waiting when the time through began and dancing after the shift**. A mid-cycle progression changes which couples are out, and a couple's `wait-out` is planned in `planCycle`'s after-the-fact fill, which never writes back to the set model: so the first call that couple dances starts from where the *model* thinks they are while their own hold-place started from where the `wait-out` really left them, and the two are one place and one line apart - `sqrt(32^2 + 20^2)`. Closing it means the fill advancing the model, which is a change to how every dance's outs are planned. **One ruling the measurement did not support**, and it is recorded rather than taken: the clause was also measured with the shift applied to A1's promenade (closure 89-158 px, worse everywhere) and as a **model-only** shift that moves the relations without moving the seating (closure 5.77-52.50 px, reach 41-60 px short). The form committed - seating and relations together, at the cast-back - is the best of the three on reach by a factor of ten and is the one the milestone brief describes.

go-forward.describe: On your own, walk forward one place along the line you are standing in, still looking the way you were looking, while the dancer beside you casts back into the place behind them.

walkthrough.short: Walk forward one place along your own line while the dancer beside you casts back.
walkthrough.long: On your own, walk forward one place along the line you are standing in, still looking the way you were looking, while the dancer beside you casts back into the place behind them. Nobody's hand: the two of you are dancing different figures in the same two beats.
